meta.name: update-skills
meta.description: Re-apply your installed skills to pull their latest code from upstream.

copy.tagline: 重新应用已安装的技能以拉取最新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已安装多个技能并希望保持它们最新
copy.tagline_en: Re-apply installed skills to pull their latest code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have installed skills and want to keep them up-to-date

howto.what: 安装后，你可以让 Claude 更新已装好的技能。它会检查项目状态、列出可更新的技能，你选出要更新的，它就从上游拉取最新代码重新安装，并运行构建和测试。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中运行 /update-skills，并且项目没有未提交的改动时触发；若有改动，需先提交或暂存。

say.text: 运行 /update-skills，把所有已安装技能更新到最新。
say.note: 逐个重新应用并跑测试。

say.text: 重新应用 Slack 技能，拉取上游最新代码。
say.note: 它会调用 /add-slack 完成更新。

say.text: 列出当前可更新的技能，我只要更新 Discord。
say.note: 通过交互选择要更新的技能。

howto.what_en: After installation, you can ask Claude to update installed skills. It checks project status, lists updatable skills, and after you select, pulls the latest code from upstream, re-applies, and runs build and tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run /update-skills in Claude Code, provided the working tree is clean; otherwise commit or stash first.

say_en.text: Run /update-skills to update all installed skills.
Re-apply the Slack skill and pull the latest upstream code.
List updatable skills; I only want to update Discord.
